status: Native Inventory movement history verified across all inventory_ledger sources

behavior.sources: inventory_ledger covers fulfillment, stock_count, transfer, POS, PMS, returns, transit, landed cost, manufacturing and operational consumption
behavior.scope: current Account/Holding authority, rendered-context CAS, inventory.read, inventory.stock-core purchase, Company and optional branch scope
behavior.pagination: 50 rows per page with a created_at:id cursor; next cursor only when an overflow row exists
behavior.atomicity: serializable read with inventory_ledger/products/warehouses share locks

cases: POS sale, return and kitchen movements appear newest-first with source/order/quantity facts
branch scope filters to the selected branch
50 rows plus one overflow row produce a next cursor and the next page returns the remainder
HTTP read with the real cookie/CAS returns the movement page; an invalid cursor is 422
checks.gates: cargo clippy private-field-api, typecheck, structure, architecture, docs, catalogue (33 modules, 784 suites), rust-runtime-foundation 6/6

limits: This is the Inventory-owned movement-history projection. Source-specific issue/transfer/count commands remain with their owning modules; the Field issue writer is already native.
The browser exercised POS sale and return sources; the PostgreSQL view covers the remaining source tables structurally.
The stock page falls back to the legacy commercePage movements when ERPX_NATIVE_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY_CONFIG is absent.
